summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj filed a Form 6-K attaching three stock exchange releases dated July 14, 2026, disclosing the receipt of shares by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (Barbara Venneman, Hannu Martola, and Sierk Pöttering) as a share-based incentive at a price of EUR 0 per share. This is a routine insider transaction notification under Finnish regulation, reported via a foreign private issuer current report on Form 6-K. No special situation event (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is involved. The filing serves as a standard compliance disclosure for equity awards to board members.
